# SD13-E3 deterministic Human Barbarian level 1 martial chassis baseline fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Barbarian level 1 chassis as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and stays a single-class, level-1-only martial chassis baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later martial burden surface: no base-attack or
# base-save progression (full BAB / good Fortitude / poor Reflex / poor Will),
# no fast-movement +10 ft. racial-class speed extension, no illiteracy trait
# enforcement, no rage execution (rage rounds, rage powers, greater rage,
# tireless rage), no weapon familiarity, no level-2+ martial progression, and
# no unarmed-strike damage reduction. It adds only the minimum feat, equipment,
# and selected-skill posture needed to make the bounded level-1 martial chassis
# legible; the barbarian base-attack, base-save, fast-movement, and illiteracy
# burdens are intentionally left for the runtime and matrix to name as still
# blocking.

race_id=race:human
class_level=class:barbarian:1
ability=strength:16
